notes.title: Welcome back, Space Marines!
notes.content:
Are You Ready to Purge, AGAIN?  

The Emperor looked kindly upon us and blessed us with a long-awaited sequel for retro boomer shooter Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun!   

Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 was just announced at the Warhammer Skulls Showcase and you can check out the reveal trailer below 👇

[previewyoutube=rG19wrCGR5g;full][/previewyoutube]

An All-New Adventure! 

Following directly on from the end of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, your duty takes you to new locations in a branching, single-player campaign that effortlessly blends the grimdark Warhammer 40:000 universe with a fast-paced first-person shooter.   

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629822/25bd6ec8adfb4883ee01635fef47ba7d96168207.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629822/9d1665068334f0f96e58da3763794407e2697c9d.jpg

Make sure to wishlist Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 on Steam to be notified when it releases!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115160/Warhammer_40000_Boltgun_2/

If you want to stay up to date with all the latest updates in its development, then the best way is to join our Discord or sign up to our mailing list. 

And if you haven’t already, now is the perfect time to play Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun as it’s currently on sale!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2005010/Warhammer_40000_Boltgun/

Brothers! War Calls You. Will You Answer? 

Don’t miss the other title we announced at the Warhammer Skulls Showcase:  

Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun – Words of Vengeance is a hilarious twist on Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, where you condemn heretics to death with every keystroke! This is a gruesome first-person typer, where your greatest weapon is your WPM (words-per-minute) ⌨️ 

Check out the launch trailer below 👇

[previewyoutube=5l-3morfa24;full][/previewyoutube]

Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun – Words of Vengeance is available to play FOR FREE on Steam right now! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3533730/Warhammer_40000_Boltgun__Words_of_Vengeance/
